parts.description: LLC isolation transformer, ETD29 core, 4:1:1 turns ratio, 110µH magnetizing inductance
alternatives_considered: Coilcraft - Custom design service (lead time 2-4 weeks)
Würth Elektronik 750343373 series - Check turns ratio compatibility
Pulse Electronics PA4000 series - Verify specifications

deviation.reason: LLC transformers with specific turns ratio (4:1:1), magnetizing inductance (110µH), and center-tap secondary are not standard catalog parts. Custom design required.
deviation.impact: Board cannot be fully assembled by JLCPCB. Transformer must be pre-consigned to JLCPCB or hand-assembled after PCBA.
deviation.mitigation: Work with custom magnetics supplier (Coilcraft, Würth, or local winder) to manufacture transformer to specification in transformer_calculations.md. Lead time: 2-4 weeks. Cost estimate: $15-30/unit for qty 10-100.
deviation.assembly_note: CRITICAL: This part MUST be pre-consigned to JLCPCB or the board will arrive without the transformer and require hand-assembly.

verification_required: Hipot test 2000V DC for 1 second (1500V rated)
Verify turns ratio with LCR meter or winding resistance ratio

assembly_blockers: T1: LLC transformer - EXTERNAL SOURCING REQUIRED
